title: Trace respects ideal-valued congruence on a finite free module
statement: Let C be a commutative ring, W an additive commutative group with a finite free C-module structure, J an ideal of C, and u,v ∈ End_C(W). If (u−v)w ∈ J • ⊤ for every w ∈ W, then tr_C(u)−tr_C(v) ∈ J.
lean_statement: ∀ {C W : Type} [CommRing C] [AddCommGroup W] [Module C W] [Module.Free C W] [Module.Finite C W] (J : Ideal C) (u v : Module.End C W), (∀ w : W, (u - v) w ∈ J • (⊤ : Submodule C W)) → LinearMap.trace C W u - LinearMap.trace C W v ∈ J
